title: Type-Safe @dynamicMemberLookup with Key Paths
hints: A `@dynamicMemberLookup` subscript can take a `WritableKeyPath<Value, T>` instead of a `String`.
Getter reads `value[keyPath: keyPath]`; setter logs then writes it.
Key paths are `Hashable`, so `[PartialKeyPath<Value>: String]` can map them to names.
